author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)

chapters.CHEM 3A: Chapter 5: The Mole and Chemical Formulas
chapters.CHEM 1A: Chapter 3: Composition of Substances and Solutions (OpenStax 3.1–3.4)

description: Mole practice for CHEM 3A Chapter 5 (default) and CHEM 1A Chapter 3. Learn Trail stops with worked examples and step-by-step help: What Is a Mole?, Molar Mass, Grams ↔ Moles, Atoms in a Formula, the Mole Road Map, Percent Composition, Empirical Formula, Molecular Formula, and for CHEM 1A Hydrates, Combustion Analysis, and Molarity & Dilution. Practice Quests (Mixed, Mole Road Map with 1–5 step trips, Molar Mass Lab, Percent Composition, Formula Finder, CHEM 1A Solution Lab) and a 10-question Skill Check Prep with a study plan. Includes a picture for every Learn Trail stop, a hands-on Mole Machine (pick a substance, slide the mass, watch moles and particles change), an interactive Mole Road Map, conversion-factor cards with decoys, common-mistake feedback, sig-fig coaching with Yellow Sheet values (Avogadro's number 6.0221 × 10²³), formula answers, E-notation input, XP, ranks, achievements, the Yellow Sheet, and matched ItsDrDan videos that jump to the right moment. Add ?course=1A to open in CHEM 1A.
